This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Thrall]] was part of the forces that attacked the rear guard of [[Kaye Galfridian]]'s invasion force as they attempted to rescue the captives of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] on the planet of [[Dibrook]].

When the thrall was surrounded by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces, Galfridian disabled her by striking her with the buttstock of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] then tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her, but Galfridian prevented that and ordered him and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] to take the prisoner back to the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]''.
